claim: A cluster mode enabled cluster can have a higher number of shards and a lower number of replicas totaling up to 90 nodes per cluster, ranging from 90 shards and 0 replicas to 15 shards and 5 replicas, which is the maximum number of replicas allowed. The 90-node figure can be raised: the node or shard limit can be increased to a maximum of 500 per cluster if the engine version is Valkey 7.2 and higher, or Redis OSS 5.0.6 to 7.1.

values.spoken: a maximum of five hundred per cluster

qualifiers.scope: per Valkey or Redis OSS cluster mode enabled cluster
qualifiers.condition: 90 nodes can be increased to a maximum of 500 per cluster on Valkey 7.2 and higher or Redis OSS 5.0.6 to 7.1

evidence.quote: You can create a cluster with higher number of shards and lower number of replicas totaling up to 90 nodes per cluster. This cluster configuration can range from 90 shards and 0 replicas to 15 shards and 5 replicas, which is the maximum number of replicas allowed.
The node or shard limit can be increased to a maximum of 500 per cluster if the engine version is Valkey 7.2 and higher, or Redis OSS 5.0.6 to 7.1.
